audience.en: Today’s sports stadiums and arenas still use similar ideas to manage their audiences.
audience.zh: 今天的体育场馆和竞技场仍然使用类似的想法来管理观众。

audience.en: And in front of an audience of people, I completely forgot my words.
audience.zh: 结果在观众面前，我把词全忘光了。

audience.en: The boxing scandal had brought his name to a national audience, but for the wrong reasons.
audience.zh: 那场拳击丑闻虽然让他的名字传遍全国，但原因却并不光彩。

audience.en: Then they write a poem about it all and perform that back to the audience.
audience.zh: 然后他们把这一切写成一首诗，并在观众面前表演出来。

audience.en: And the audience, at least most of the time, roars with laughter.
audience.zh: 而观众，至少在大多数时候，都会爆发出大笑。

author.en: Jen Lin-Liu, author of the book 'On the Noodle Road', doesn't believe this story.
author.zh: 《面条之路》一书的作者珍·林-刘并不相信这个说法。

author.en: But Maryanne Wolf, author of the book Reader Come Home, says that this isn't true.
author.zh: 但《阅读，回到祖国吧》（Reader Come Home）一书的作者玛丽安娜·沃尔夫（Maryanne Wolf）表示，事实并非如此。

author.en: Professor Karen Dillon is the author of a book on twins in American literature and a twin herself.
author.zh: 凯伦·狄龙教授是一本关于美国文学中双胞胎的书的作者，她自己也是个双胞胎。

author.en: Australian authors became famous. And sports like rugby league and Australian rules and cricket became the symbols of Australian culture.
author.zh: 澳大利亚作家名声大噪。而像英式橄榄球联盟、澳式橄榄球和板球这样的运动，则成为了澳大利亚文化的象征。

author.en: His worst fears were confirmed; to David Kaczynski, it was undeniable that the author of the Unabomber’s Manifesto and his older brother, Ted, were the same person.
author.zh: 他最担忧的事情得到了证实；对大卫·卡钦斯基来说，Unabomber 宣言的作者和他的哥哥泰德毫无疑问是同一个人。

authority.en: The physical presence of the authority figure, it turned out, was an important factor.
authority.zh: 事实证明，权威人物是否亲身在场，是一个重要因素。

authority.en: Many expected that even if the empire had collapsed, Turkey would retain this religious authority.
authority.zh: 许多人曾预计，即使帝国崩溃，土耳其也会保留这种宗教权威。

authority.en: The authorities at first couldn’t figure out the connection between these people.
authority.zh: 当局起初无法找出这些人之间的联系。

authority.en: In 2015, US and Swiss authorities launched a major investigation into FIFA and into FIFA officials.
authority.zh: 2015年，美国和瑞士当局对国际足联及国际足联官员展开了一场重大调查。

authority.en: To the authorities, the Unabomber was not simply dangerous; he was invisible.
authority.zh: 在当局看来，The Unabomber 不仅危险，而且隐形。

automatic.en: The habit of code switching when things get difficult slows down the development of your automatic fluency.
automatic.zh: 当事情变难时就进行语码转换的习惯会减慢你自动流利度的发展。

automatic.en: In earned settlement, things like permanent residence and citizenship are not automatic after a number of years.
automatic.zh: 在 earned settlement 这种模式下，永久居留和国籍在几年后不再是自动获得的。

automatic.en: Conscious switching, thinking about it, can be useful, but automatic switching can stop you from practicing your English properly.
automatic.zh: 有意识地切换，即对此进行思考，可能会很有用，但自动切换会阻止你正确地练习英语。

automatic.en: It’s overwhelming. But after a while, it becomes automatic.
automatic.zh: 这让人不知所措。但过了一会儿，它就变成自动的了。

automatic.en: France, for its part, has long operated under a more inclusive model, with automatic or semi-automatic citizenship for children born in France to foreign parents who have lived in the country.
automatic.zh: 至于法国，长期以来一直奉行更具包容性的模式，对在法国出生且父母长期居住在该国的外国儿童自动或半自动授予国籍。

automate.en: Turing proved that logic could be mechanized, could be automated.
automate.zh: Turing 证明了逻辑可以被机械化、可以被自动化。

automate.en: There are also image generators that can create pictures from words, and many companies are using AI to automate tasks that used to need people, like answering customer questions or analyzing data.
automate.zh: 还有能根据文字创作图片的图像生成器，许多公司正在使用AI来自动化那些原本需要人工来完成的任务，比如回答客户问题或分析数据。

automate.en: This is not a question of whether there would be thousands of astronauts with hammers and shovels physically digging the surface themselves, and lugging large sacks back at the end of the day, but rather whether the mine would be 100% automated, controlled from back on Earth or from a space mission closer to Earth, or whether there would be human astronauts monitoring the situation from the site, just in case anything went wrong.
automate.zh: 这并不是说会有成千上万的宇航员拿着锤子和铁锹亲自在表面挖掘，最后背着大麻袋回来，而是说这个矿场会是 100% 自动化的，由地球后方或距离地球更近的太空任务进行控制，亦或是会有宇航员在现场监控情况以防万一出现任何差错。

authentic.en: In many cases, certain emotions feel more authentic or real in a specific language.
authentic.zh: 在许多情况下，某些情感在特定的语言中会感觉更真实或更真切。
